name: Sign-in Card

name: OTP Code Cells
note: Six single-character inputs wired as one field: auto-advance, backspace and arrow navigation, and a paste handler that spreads a pasted code across every cell.
html:

name: Passkey Prompt
note: Biometric passkey sheet that drives idle, scanning and authenticated states from one data attribute, with CSS sweep rings over an inline fingerprint.
html:
Use your passkey

Sign in to Northwind as ada@northwind.io

name: Provider Button Row
note: Federated sign-in block combining one wide primary provider, a three-up icon row and an email fallback, each button owning its own busy state and per-provider hover accent.
html:
or

name: Password Strength Meter
note: Local-only strength gauge that estimates entropy from character-pool size, penalises repeats, runs and common words, and drives four bars plus a live requirement checklist.
html:

name: Two-Factor Step
note: Two-factor step with an arrow-key roving radiogroup of methods and a self-clearing 30-second TOTP ring driven by stroke-dashoffset.
html:

name: Magic Link Sent
note: Post-send confirmation that runs one interval for both the link expiry clock and the resend cooldown, and swaps the address for an inline editor on demand.
html:

name: Account Switcher
note: Popover account list using roving tabindex with arrow, Home and End keys, aria-pressed for the live session, and monogram avatars tinted from per-row hue variables.
